newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse extends gain to around 2,700.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse extends gain to around 2,700.

text.p: French shares extended their gains, bolstered by gains on Wall Street and higher bond prices on receding fears of a disruption in the EMU timetable.
* CAC-40 index up 34.62, or 1.3 percent, at 2,698.8 at 1021 GMT after running into psychological resistance at the 2,700 level
* CAC-40 Jun futures 2,683 vs 2,647 at Tuesdays close
* Volume was a moderate 3.3 billion francs. "It's very quiet and there's still a lot of uncertainty in this market," a broker said.
